The '''''Black & White'' arc''' (Japanese: '''ブラック・ホワイト編''' ''Black & White arc''), also referred to as '''''The Tenth Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第十章''' ''The Tenth Chapter''), is the tenth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, consisting of nine volumes. It began serialization in September 2010, and ended in June 2013.

This arc follows the adventures of {{Adv|Black}}, who is on a quest to become the {{pkmn|Champion}} of the {{un|Pokémon League}}. He is joined by {{adv|White}}, a young woman who owns the Pokémon acting company, the [[BW Agency]], and aims to raise the best Pokémon actor. As they travel through the [[Unova]] region, they encounter the organization known as [[Team Plasma]], which is aiming to separate Pokémon from their Trainers, and their mysterious king, {{adv|N}}.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series games]], [[Pokémon Black and White Versions|Pokémon Black and White]].

===Mini-volumes===
{{main|List of Pokémon Black and White volumes}}
Before the collection of chapters from the ''Black & White'' arc of Pokémon Adventures began in {{PAV|43}} in Japan, the chapters were collected directly from the magazine publications into mini-graphic novels by [[VIZ Media]] in North America. These volumes, published under the title '''''Pokémon Black and White''''' and advertised as "a Pokémon Adventures special edition", retail for $4.99 USD and contain about three or four chapters each. The first two volumes were released on July 5, 2011 with subsequent volumes following until the release of volume 20 which was released on February 3, 2015.

A [[Manga boxed sets#Black & White chapter|box set]] of the first eight volumes was released on October 2, 2012 including a special full-color poster. A second box set, containing volumes 9 through 14, was released on September 2, 2014. The third and final box set, containing volumes 15 through 20 was released on September 1, 2015.

====In other languages====
=====French=====
{{main|List of Pokémon Black and White volumes (France)}}
A French translation of the ''Black & White'' arc has been produced separately in {{pmin|France}} by publisher Kurokawa. Unlike the VIZ Media versions, which are slimmer than a typical volume and only contain three or four chapters, the French versions are a more typical volume size and contain about eight chapters each. Like VIZ Media's version, these are collected directly from the magazine publication. The first of these volumes was published in September 2011 with subsequent releases until the release of Volume 9 on October 9, 2014.

====German====
A German translation of the ''Black & White'' arc has been produced in {{pmin|Germany}} by publisher Panini Comics. Unlike the VIZ Media versions, which are slimmer than a typical volume and only contain three or four chapters, the German versions are a more typical volume size and contain about eight chapters each. Like VIZ Media's version, these are collected directly from the magazine publication. The first of these volumes was published on October 8, 2013 with subsequent releases until the release of Volume 9 on August 17, 2015.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
{{main|Timeline of events in Pokémon Adventures#Black & White arc|Timeline of events in the Black & White arc of Pokémon Adventures}}
*{{adv|Black}}, {{adv|Cheren}}, and {{adv|Bianca}} start their journey and receive their [[Pokédex]]es.
* Black meets {{adv|White}} and starts working for her company, the BW Agency.
* Black and White encounter [[Team Plasma]] for the first time and fight {{adv|N}}.
* [[Clay]] informs [[Lenora]] about the [[Dark Stone]] he found. [[Shadow Triad]] spies them.
* Black meets the [[Seven Sages]] for the first time.
* N reveals that he is Team Plasma's king.
* White decides to train in the [[Battle Subway]].
* The members of {{adv|forces of nature}} are captured by Team Plasma.
* Team Plasma attacks the {{DL|Nacrene City|Nacrene Museum}} and seizes the Dark Stone, kidnapping the [[Gym Leader]]s apart from [[Brycen]].
* N awakens {{p|Zekrom}} and tames it. {{p|Reshiram}}, as Light Stone, chooses Black as its hero.
* Bianca gives her Pokédex to White.
* N defeats [[Alder]].
* {{un|Pokémon League}} starts. Black defeats Cheren in the finals.
* Black and Reshiram defeat N and Zekrom, and later [[Ghetsis]]. N bids farewell.
* Black is sealed into the Light Stone with Reshiram and disappears.
* As the defeated Team Plasma Grunts flee, {{adv|Whitley|one}} of them receives a [[Foongy|Foongus]] and a locket containing N's photograph.
